# 2 Baruch Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**20:1** "Therefore the-time-of-the-world shall-be-shortened for-those-who-dwell-in-it, because-they-have-sinned greatly.

**20:2** For-the-Most-High has-waxed-impatient-with-those-who-inhabit-the-earth; and-he-will-not-spare-them from-that-time.

**20:3** Command-your-memory therefore to-go-into-the-forest, and-direct-it to-call-for-sorrow and-mourn-for-you there; for if-you-remain-there and-fast-seven-days, then-again-shall-I-come-to-you, and-I-will-speak-to-you concerning-what-shall-come-upon-the-nations.

**20:4** And-you-shall-learn-what-shall-come and-shall-happen-after-these-things. For-your-prayer-has-been-heard-before-the-Most-High; and-the-holy-angels-have-been-sent-to-you, and-they-have-kept-you-safe-until-this-time.

**20:5** For-I-will-not-let-them-depart from-you until-the-completion-of-that-which-I-have-told-you.

**20:6** And-he-said to-me also: "Behold I-will-establish-my-covenant with-you and-with-your-seed, from-this-time-forth forever; and-I-will-not-forget-your-memorial but-will-remember-it forever."

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 20 transitions from dialogue to action. Baruch is sent to fast seven days in the forest to receive the next revelation (chs. 21ff.). V.6 is a covenant renewal echoing Jer 31 and Gen 17.*
